newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets 15 day tender at fixed 3.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets 15 day tender at fixed 3.00 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Monday it was setting a tender for 15-day securities repurchase funds at a fixed 3.00 percent.
Funds will be credited to accounts on Tuesday and the securities have to be repurchased on May 14. The tender was set for one day longer than usual due to Thursday's holiday.
A 59.9 billion mark facility in a 12-day tender at a fixed rate of 3.00 percent expires on Wednesday.
A 14-day facility at 82.4 billion marks was set last week.
